description: SessionStart hook to inject clipboard-copy MCP tool directives, and a PreToolUse hook to block native clipboard-write Bash commands and route them to the clipboard-copy MCP tools.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$root" ] && [ -x ./hooks/scripts/session-start.sh ]; then root=.; fi; if [ -z "$root" ] && [ -x ./plugins/clipboard-copy/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh ]; then root=./plugins/clipboard-copy; fi; if [ -n "$root" ]; then exec "$root/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh"; fi; exit 0'

bash -lc 'root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$root" ] && [ -x ./hooks/scripts/check-clipboard.sh ]; then root=.; fi; if [ -z "$root" ] && [ -x ./plugins/clipboard-copy/hooks/scripts/check-clipboard.sh ]; then root=./plugins/clipboard-copy; fi; if [ -n "$root" ]; then exec bash "$root/hooks/scripts/check-clipboard.sh"; fi; cat >/dev/null; exit 0'
